engine: to-place.co.jp's full-bleed video handoff — a PINNED, wheel/touch-STEPPED, input-LOCKED stack of full-viewport <video> panels where each discrete step WIPES the next video VERTICALLY over the last (new panel rises from the bottom; ONE horizontal seam travels upward) with a transient scale/overshoot SETTLE; per-card PLAYBACK GATING (only the active video decodes/plays); fixed play-pause + audio-waveform chrome above everything. Built for Higgsfield image->video reels: poster = the still -> first painted frame = the still -> the reveal reads as STILL -> MOTION. Harvested from D_toplace_video.md (§3).

measured_teardown.move: PINNED section. A GSAP Observer (wheel/touch/pointer) increments an index; INPUT is LOCKED until the step timeline finishes (the snap feel). PER STEP (~0.8s, expo.out): incoming panel yPercent dir*100 -> 0 (+ scale overshoot 0.94 -> 1 settle); outgoing panel yPercent 0 -> -dir*100. ONE horizontal seam travels up (the two real video panels split by a single line). PLAYBACK GATE (event-driven): on becoming active -> video.play(); on leaving -> video.pause() (pause only, no seek) — ONLY ONE video decodes at a time. CHROME (fixed, never moves during a wipe): wordmark; a circular play/pause toggle; an audio-waveform that animates while playing and freezes/flattens to a pause glyph when paused; the toggle is INDEPENDENT of scroll. At the last card the Observer disables so the page scrolls on (reverse releases up).
measured_teardown.cited: to-place interior walkthrough: full-bleed interior VIDEOs that swap one-per-scroll-step via a vertical wipe (e-018 seam ~50%, f-025 ~46% = vertical travel; e-006 = a transient inset+blur settle before snapping to full-bleed e-030/f-029); top-left TO PLACE wordmark + diamond; top-right circular play/pause + 4-5 bar waveform (tall f-022 playing vs squat f-040 paused). No per-card captions — pure imagery.

overshoot.what: incoming panel's starting scale (settles to 1) — the cinematic settle.

lazy.what: only mount/buffer current +/-1 video (data-src promoted on approach).

loop.what: wrap at the ends (true) or release the pin so the page scrolls on (false).

autoplayActive.what: autoplay the active card's video (muted) on becoming active.

manageLenis.what: own a Lenis instance if present; false when a shared page Lenis drives scroll.

entry: VideoCardReveal.create(target, opts) -> { trigger, observer, lenis, go(i), next(), prev(), toggle(), index (getter), refresh(), destroy }. target = .vcr-stage > .vcr-viewport ( .vcr-card > video[muted loop playsinline poster][src OR data-src for lazy] x N ) + .vcr-chrome ( .vcr-wordmark + .vcr-toggle( .vcr-wave > .vcr-bar x N ) + .vcr-index ). next/prev/go drive the wipe; toggle() play/pauses the active video.
law: transform(translateY, scale) + opacity only; GPU; NO mix-blend; NO WebGL; NEVER scrub video.currentTime (scroll-driven-hero law — the video AUTOPLAYS, the scroll STEPS the panels). The active video alone decodes (gate on becoming active/leaving). reduced-motion or <=820px -> a native vertical scroll-snap of the cards + IntersectionObserver playback gating, no pin/lock. owns_pin TRUE (one pinned section for the card stack). GSAP + ScrollTrigger + Observer required for the stepped path; the static path needs neither. poster = the Higgsfield still (first paint = still). playsinline + muted so mobile autoplays.
gate_mode: a pinned, wheel-stepped video stack. Verify: scroll into the section -> it pins; each wheel/touch step WIPES the next full-bleed video up from the bottom (one horizontal seam) + a scale settle; only the active video plays (others paused); input is locked during a step (a double-step advances only one); the play/pause toggle + waveform reflect audio state and are independent of scroll; at the last card the pin releases. NOTE: Observer wheel is unreliable headless — drive via api.next()/prev()/go(); scroll past the first 100vh spacer to engage the pin before screenshotting.
proven: lab: 3 full-bleed video cards (poster stills + clip-river / nahirna-water sources, lazy data-src) on a charcoal stage with TO PLACE wordmark + diamond, a circular play/pause + 5-bar waveform, a 'NN / 03' index. Observer registered, __LAB_OK__ true. INITIAL GATE: only card 0 plays (paused:false, others paused). MID-WIPE: card 0 at translateY -90% (exiting up), card 1 at +9.9% mid-rise from 100% + scale 0.994 (overshoot settle), card 2 at 100% — the vertical wipe with one seam up + scale settle. AFTER STEP: idx 1, counter 02/03, playing [false,true,false] (gate follows active). INPUT LOCK: rapid double-next advanced only +1 (locked until step finished). TOGGLE: play->pause works, waveform reflects state. Posters set on all 3 (first paint = still -> still->motion); incoming card after settle plays (1920px, readyState 4). Pin engages (stageTop 0, fills viewport). Zero console errors. Smoothness probe (4x CPU throttle, 3 wipes): 195 frames, 2.05% long frames -> PASS. Screenshots: settled = full-bleed playing video + fixed chrome; mid-wipe = one horizontal seam travelling up + index 02/03 + chrome stationary. Relatives (all differ): fullscreen-media-carousel (HORIZONTAL translateX swipe + arrows/counter), hero-video-render-rotator (passive opacity crossfade under a fixed title), render-slice-reveal/center-seam-split (centre seam on ONE fixed render), media-step-switch (ONE fixed surface, scrubbed), panel-rise-over (a coloured theme panel, scrubbed). This is the only discrete-wheel-stepped + input-locked, full-bleed VIDEO panels translating vertically, with per-card play/decode gating (poster->motion). For Higgsfield reels: each render = poster still -> autoplay clip, one full-bleed hero at a time, vertical-wipe handoff. Serif chrome = Playfair Display.
